The new [UTS Business School](http://www.smh.com.au/entertainment/art-and-design/gehry-competes-with-ghosts-for-architectural-vision-20101216-18zqq.html "UTS Business School") building. [Here’s Gehry](http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/12/16/3094936.htm?section=entertainment "Here’s Gehry") selling us on his design:

> Mr Gehry says it is inevitable that any new building draws some criticism, but he hopes that ultimately Australia will embrace the project.
>
> “A lot of junk is built in cities around the world and nobody really complains,” he said. “This is a small building. I don’t think it is going to destroy the town, I promise.”
